<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a clear M+2 peak at roughly one‑third the intensity of the monoisotopic peak, characteristic of a single chlorine atom, together with the regular 1 Da spacing and a modest M+1 peak consistent with 13C— the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
